correctness.rationale: Exact three-eigenvalue star decomposition and direct Butcher-derived rational function give all endpoint entries. F(x)=(1-r(x))/x is strictly positive and decreasing, proving all offdiagonals positive. The scalar minimum r(w*)=-eta makes balanced stars with 2–4 leaves positive. For every m>=5 and every rate ratio, either z>3+2sqrt(2) yields a negative hub diagonal, or z<=3+2sqrt(2) yields a leaf diagonal bounded above by (297-211sqrt(2))/98<0; radical sign checked exactly. The full extracted verifier passed 2827 assertions, 420 direct-RK matrix comparisons; finite tests are diagnostic and do not replace proof.

value.rationale: Model rates alter the discrete positivity of transition probabilities despite L-stability and exact CTMC positivity. The six-state cutoff proves that no homogeneous rate tuning can remove an intermediate negative endpoint on larger stars and gives a constructive positive all-step choice on smaller ones. This is a natural sharp classifier for a widely used implicit integrator/Markov network pair, with explicit failure steps and sign location.
